workflow: DreamLoop Pro: existing screenshot, generated in-engine target, iterative implementation and independent visual review

target.promptSummary: Preserve the existing camera, FOV, retro pixel rendering, HUD, hands, weapon and walkable bridge. Render a volcanic cathedral with a centered basalt gothic arch, three lancets, outer lava piers, ribbed vault, low amber lava and readable charcoal stone. Target is an in-engine game screenshot. This is a summary, not the verbatim prompt.

atlasV1.promptSummary: Four-quadrant game material atlas matching the target: basalt masonry, paving, bronze trim and orange glowing glass. This is a summary, not the verbatim prompt.

atlasV2.runtimeUse: Upper-right paving only; v1 supplies the remaining three quadrants.

runtime.encoding: Four 128x128 RGB base64 buffers, box-area averaged from atlas quadrants, decoded synchronously offline
runtime.geometry: Native procedural scene meshes; no downloaded third-party 3D assets
runtime.lightingLimitation: Tagged static hell surfaces use baked vertex illumination and do not respond to dynamic muzzle lights. Other normally lit objects retain native lighting.
